## Gate 2.5 findings + architect recommendation
Gate 2.5 - Findings & Dispositions (model=mimo-v2.6-flash sha=ecea6eb5d02c)
**Overall architect recommendation: APPROVE**
Findings: 5 (BLOCKER 0 / MAJOR 0 / MINOR 4 / NIT 1); dispositions: actioned 4, pending 1; all blockers/majors actioned
status: PENDING | ACTIONED | ACCEPTED | DEFERRED | REJECTED | SCOPE

| # | Severity | Finding | Disposition | Response / resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MINOR | `review_select.py` delta: `norm.replace("_", "")` is unbounded string mangling instead of an explicit status alias map; `won_tfix`→`wontfix`-style collisions can silently widen the closed set, weakening the "closed status comes from the authoritative backlog" invariant (design contract, `is_closed` hunk). | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 tooling/tests. |
| 2 | MINOR | The new `test_mixed_case_closed_status` passes via the raw-lower branch if `CLOSED_STATUSES` already contains `wont_fix`, so the added `replace("_","")` path may have zero coverage; add a case only reachable through normalization to prove which branch decides closure. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 tooling/tests. |
| 3 | MINOR | Prior finding disposition=ACTIONED is not fully substantiated: no delta test asserts the printed `mtime_fallback=` line end-to-end with populated `meta` (the new tests cover `skipped_closed`/`item=` and `is_closed` only), so the observability half of AC-3 for the mtime path remains untested. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 tooling/tests. |
| 4 | MINOR | `test_item_closed_skip_output` stubs `backlog.get_epic`, so it verifies skip plumbing/output shape but not that a real authoritative closed status reaches `is_closed`; combined with the underscore change, the authority→skip wiring is only indirectly covered. | ACTIONED | Addressed in BI-PF-1536 tooling/tests. |
| 5 | NIT | `test_item_closed_skip_output` asserts loose substrings (`skipped_closed=1`, `item=BI-PF-7`) without pinning `status=ok` on the same line, so a regression that reports skip but still fails the item would pass the test. | PENDING | (no response yet) |

--- SUMMARY (review) ---
  Delta correctly resolves the pending greppability NIT (`item=<id>`) and adds closed-skip/mixed-case tests; no blockers and no AC regression in the delta.
  Top risks: the underscore-normalization in `is_closed` is an implicit, possibly untested widening of the closed set, and one prior disposition (printed `mtime_fallback` observability) is marked ACTIONED without covering evidence.
  Recommend explicit status aliasing plus one end-to-end assertion of the printed fallback marker before merge.
=== 5 finding(s), 1 pending ===
